title: Commercial Bank of Kuwait - Social Content, Motion Graphics and 3D Animation Retainer
description: Commercial Bank of Kuwait worked with Astroshot for around three years as a high-end social media content partner. Astroshot supported CBK with 3D animation, motion graphics, video production, static artwork, brochures, flyers, billboards, social media assets and branch-screen content. The work helped explain banking products and services quickly and clearly, including cards, app features, ATMs, cash withdrawal machines, branch announcements, Mastercard benefits, Ramadan, donation and salary transfer campaigns.
